variables.name: STUDYID
variables.label: Study Identifier
variables.description: Unique identifier for a study.

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.label: Domain Abbreviation
variables.description: Two-character abbreviation for the domain.

variables.name: USUBJID
variables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
variables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product.

variables.name: SPDEVID
variables.label: Sponsor Device Identifier
variables.description: Sponsor-defined identifier for a device.

variables.name: BSSEQ
variables.label: Sequence Number
variables.description: Sequence number given to ensure uniqueness within a dataset for a subject. May be any valid number (including decimals) and does not have to start at 1.

variables.name: BSGRPID
variables.label: Group ID
variables.description: Optional group identifier, used to link together a block of related records within a subject in a domain.

variables.name: BSREFID
variables.label: Reference ID
variables.description: Internal or external identifier such as lab specimen ID.

variables.name: BSSPID
variables.label: Sponsor-Defined Identifier
variables.description: Sponsor-defined identifier.

variables.name: BSTESTCD
variables.label: Biospecimen Test Short Name
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C124300
variables.description: Short character value for BSTEST used as a column name when converting a dataset from a vertical format to a horizontal format. The short value can be up to 8 characters. Examples: VOLUME, RIN.

variables.name: BSTEST
variables.label: Biospecimen Test Name
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C124299
variables.description: Long name for BSTESTCD. Examples: Volume, RNA Integrity Number.

variables.name: BSCAT
variables.label: Category for Biospecimen Test
variables.description: Used to define a category of topic-variable values. Example: MEASUREMENT, QUALITY.

variables.name: BSSCAT
variables.label: Subcategory for Biospecimen Test
variables.description: Used to define a further categorization of BSCAT values.

variables.name: BSORRES
variables.label: Result or Finding in Original Units
variables.description: Result of the measurement or finding as originally received or collected.

variables.name: BSORRESU
variables.label: Original Units
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C71620
variables.description: Unit for BSORRES. Examples: mg, mL.

variables.name: BSSTRESC
variables.label: Character Result/Finding in Std Format
variables.description: Contains the result value for all findings, copied or derived from BSORRES in a standard format or standard units. BSSTRESC should store all results or findings in character format; if results are numeric, they should also be stored in numeric format in BSSTRESN.

variables.name: BSSTRESN
variables.label: Numeric Result/Finding in Standard Units
variables.description: Used for continuous or numeric results or findings in standard format; copied in numeric format from BSSTRESC. BSSTRESN should store all numeric test results or findings.

variables.name: BSSTRESU
variables.label: Standard Units
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C71620
variables.description: Standardized unit used for BSSTRESC and BSSTRESN.

variables.name: BSSTAT
variables.label: Completion Status
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66789
variables.description: Used to indicate that a test was not done, or was attempted but did not generate a result. Should be null or have a value of NOT DONE.

variables.name: BSREASND
variables.label: Reason Test Not Done
variables.description: Reason not done. Used in conjunction with BSSTAT when value is NOT DONE.

variables.name: BSNAM
variables.label: Vendor Name
variables.description: Name or identifier of the vendor (e.g., laboratory) that provided the test results.

variables.name: BSSPEC
variables.label: Specimen Type
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C78734, Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C111114
variables.description: Defines the type of specimen used for a measurement. Examples: SERUM, PLASMA, URINE, SOFT TISSUE.

variables.name: BSANTREG
variables.label: Anatomical Region of Specimen
variables.description: Defines the specific anatomical or biological region of a tissue, organ specimen or the region from which the specimen is obtained, as defined in the protocol, such as a section or part of what is described in the BSSPEC variable. Examples: CORTEX, MEDULLA, MUCOSA.

variables.name: BSSPCCND
variables.label: Specimen Condition
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C78733
variables.description: Defines the condition of the specimen. Examples: HEMOLYZED, ICTERIC, LIPEMIC.

variables.name: BSMETHOD
variables.label: Method of Test or Examination
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C85492
variables.description: Method of the test or examination. Examples: SPECTROPHOTOMETRY, ELECTROPHORESIS.

variables.name: BSBLFL
variables.label: Baseline Flag
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: Indicator used to identify a baseline value.

variables.name: VISITNUM
variables.label: Visit Number
variables.description: Clinical encounter number. Numeric version of VISIT, used for sorting.

variables.name: VISIT
variables.label: Visit Name
variables.description: Protocol-defined description of clinical encounter.

variables.name: VISITDY
variables.label: Planned Study Day of Visit
variables.description: Planned study day of VISIT. Should be an integer.

variables.name: BSDTC
variables.label: Date/Time of Specimen Collection
variables.description: Date and time of specimen collection.

variables.name: BSDY
variables.label: Study Day of Specimen Collection
variables.description: Study day of specimen collection relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC.

variables.name: BSTPT
variables.label: Planned Time Point Name
variables.description: Text description of time when a measurement or observation should be taken as defined in the protocol. This may be represented as an elapsed time relative to a fixed reference point, such as time of last dose. See BSTPTNUM and BSTPTREF.

variables.name: BSTPTNUM
variables.label: Planned Time Point Number
variables.description: Numerical version of BSTPT used in sorting.

variables.name: BSELTM
variables.label: Planned Elapsed Time from Time Point Ref
variables.description: Elapsed time relative to a planned fixed reference (BSTPTREF). This variable is useful where there are repetitive measures. Not a clock time or a date time variable, but an interval, represented as ISO duration.

variables.name: BSTPTREF
variables.label: Time Point Reference
variables.description: Name of the fixed reference point referred to by BSELTM, BSTPTNUM, and BSTPT. Examples: PREVIOUS DOSE, PREVIOUS MEAL.

variables.name: BSRFTDTC
variables.label: Date/Time of Reference Time Point
variables.description: Date/time for a fixed reference time point defined by BSTPTREF.
